programLong: Bachelor of Computer Science (Honours), Dalhousie University
head: CS student, leaning toward ML
bio: Computer science honours student at Dalhousie University, graduating May 2027. Co-op developer at SpryPoint, research assistant on Greenland ice segmentation. Looking for new grad roles.

shortVersion.rest: Worked on a Scala/Java and Knockout.js billing platform for municipal utilities: bug fixes, configuration pages, forms and tests. About 20 client-facing stories.
Worked on U-Net models and patch datasets over Landsat-8 Greenland imagery, plus an Honours study on backdoor attacks in vision models.
Grants of $1,500+ across two terms for a society of 150+ members.
